non_claims: This pin records an identity; it does not fetch, verify against, or prove anything about the live corca-ai/ceal remote.

Only `source.tree` is checked locally, against `HEAD:packages/ceal-protocol`. `source.commit` and `shipped.protocol_tree` are recorded observations that no local check can confirm: neither the working tree nor gateway-handoff-lock.json carries them. Confirming them needs the owner checkout (`git rev-parse <commit>:packages/ceal-protocol`).
`agreed` means the proof and shipment identities converged when this pin was written. It is not evidence that any release was built, installed, or accepted against the locked archive.

The `source.tree` recorded here was derived from the tagged Gateway commit (`git rev-parse gateway-handoff-v0.68.0^{commit}:packages/ceal-protocol` in a local reference checkout of corca-ai/ceal). The Gateway lane's handoff notes state the producer tree of the whole commit rather than the protocol subtree.

The archive this pin ships against exists only as a 30-day GitHub Actions artifact. It is not published under the Gateway handoff release origin that .github/workflows/ceal-release.yml downloads from, so a green pin here does not make a worker release runnable.
